steps.do: Find the existing focus rule for text inputs in styles.css.
Add transition: box-shadow 200ms ease-out to the base input rule.
Set input:focus-visible to use box-shadow 0 0 0 3px #1a73e8 as the focus ring.
Confirm the transition declaration is present in the stylesheet.
Lint the stylesheet for syntax errors.

K-020004.example: The input rule gets transition: box-shadow 200ms ease-out, and input:focus-visible gets box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1a73e8. Tabbing into the field fades the ring in over 200ms with no layout shift.
K-020004.check: rg prints a line containing 'transition: box-shadow 200ms' and npx stylelint styles.css exits with no errors.
traps: Do not use transition: all, because it animates unrelated properties.
Do not attach the ring to :focus alone, since mouse clicks would also show it.
Do not remove the outline without providing a visible replacement.

steps.do: Find where user-invalid is referenced in styles.css.
Define @keyframes shake with transform translateX at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% using 0, -4px, 4px, -4px, and 0.
Apply animation: shake 300ms ease-in-out 1 to input:user-invalid.
Run the browser test that submits a bad email and checks the animation.

K-020005.check: rg finds one @keyframes shake block and the Playwright test reports 1 passed with computed animation-duration of 0.3s.

Do not set the iteration count to infinite.
Do not exceed 8px of travel, which reads as a glitch.

steps.do: List every transition and animation declaration in form.css.
Move each transform-based motion rule inside an @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) block.
Keep color-only transitions outside the media block so they still apply under reduced motion.
Run the Playwright test that emulates reduced motion.
Lint form.css after the edit.

K-020006.check: grep shows every transform animation line inside the media block, and the Playwright test reports 1 passed.
traps: Do not set animation: none on the base rule, since that removes motion for everyone.
Do not forget that the media query uses no-preference for opt-in motion.

steps.do: Find the submit button in index.html.

Set .spinner to animation: spin 800ms linear infinite and show it only when the button has data-loading true.

K-020007.check: Playwright reports the button bounding box width is 160px before and after loading, and the spinner computed animation-name is spin.

Set .field-error.is-visible to grid-template-rows: 1fr.

Do not skip overflow hidden on the inner div, or text spills out while collapsing.

steps.do: Confirm the onboarding page answers on port 8080.
Run axe against the page for WCAG 2.0 AA rules.
Check that normal text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 and large text at least 3:1.

Confirm the spec asserts h1 font-size of 32px at 320px wide and 40px at 1280px wide.

K-020020.check: The grep for swap prints one line per @font-face block, the count prints 3, and Playwright prints all tests passed.
traps: document.fonts.check returns true only after the face is requested, so the spec must trigger text rendering first.
font-display auto or block delays text, so use swap.

traps: test -f prints nothing on success, so check the exit status instead.

In src/app.rs, call state.select(None) when the replaced vector is empty.
Otherwise clamp the stored index to the last valid row using min with the length minus one, only when the length is above zero.

steps.do: Confirm the empty state source directory exists before searching it.

Run the Playwright accessibility spec for the signup page.

K-020149.check: Playwright prints '1 passed' and the grep prints the withTags line. The axe violations array has length 0.
traps: Small models often run axe before the form finishes rendering, so the scan misses fields. Wait for the submit button to be visible first.

Create the reports folder for the Lighthouse output.
Run Lighthouse on the signup page and save only the accessibility category as JSON.
Read the accessibility score from the saved report.

K-020150.example: The preview server serves the built signup page on port 4173. The report score must be at least 0.95, which means 95 out of 100.
K-020150.check: The jq command prints a number such as 1 or 0.97, and any value below 0.95 fails the gate.
traps: Small models read the score from a stale report left by an earlier run. Delete reports/signup-a11y.json before each run.

steps.do: Run the keyboard test file that tabs through the form fields.
Count user.tab calls in the keyboard test to confirm each field is visited.
Count document.activeElement checks to confirm focus is asserted at each step.
Confirm the form has no tabIndex value above zero, which breaks natural tab order.

K-020151.example: The test calls await user.tab() three times across email, password, and submit, and checks expect(document.activeElement).toBe(screen.getByLabelText('Password')). It then presses Enter on the submit button and expects the onSubmit handler to be called once.
K-020151.check: Vitest prints 'Tests 1 passed (1)', the first grep prints 3 or more, and the tabIndex grep prints nothing.
